reserve_sequence: When an opening pivot or Eject Button creates a vacancy, give healthy survivable Yveltal the highest tempo priority while Tailwind is absent or Trick Room is active. Under ordinary speed state it may establish Tailwind; under Trick Room it must use Roseli-backed Snarl, Protect, or Oblivion Wing to consume turns and survive Fairy pressure.

Give healthy Mega Absol a specialist priority bonus when it survives and a revealed burnable physical threat or direct Knock Off or Play Rough knockout gives its disruption phase real value. This bonus is not an absolute eligibility gate: if no specialist qualifies and Absol wins the deterministic non-Kingambit fallback, it may enter for direct legal pressure without pretending the narrow job existed.

Give Darkrai a specialist priority bonus when a revealed move is worth Disabling, visible setup or recovery is worth Taunting, or Icy Wind changes ordinary move order. Under active Trick Room, suppress Icy Wind and prefer revealed Taunt or Disable or direct Dark Pulse. If no specialist qualifies and Darkrai wins the deterministic fallback, it may use direct pressure without hidden-information control.

Withhold Kingambit until at least four allies have visibly fainted and no other healthy reserve exists. If it is the only legal reserve after an unusual simultaneous-faint or forced-replacement state, select it as the explicit emergency exception. Kingambit must be the final queued reserve, never a phase followed by Absol or Darkrai.

Apply one total algorithm: withhold Kingambit while any other healthy reserve exists; score visible specialist priority for Yveltal, Absol, and Darkrai; choose the highest qualified specialist; if none qualifies, choose the healthy non-Kingambit reserve with the best visible board value, then current HP, then stable party index. A forced fallback may use direct moves but cannot invoke an unearned specialist script.

For every predicate and tie, use only revealed attacks, observed damage and turn order, visible field state, public species typing and stats, current HP, and estimated visible damage. Break equal visible-damage ties by current HP and then stable party index; never inspect hidden player data or use a rigid next-slot procession as strategy.
ordering.mandatory_order_reason: Party order preserves the authored lead and keeps Kingambit last for presentation, while one total visible-state algorithm controls every replacement. Yveltal owns ordinary tempo and active-Trick-Room survival, Absol and Darkrai receive bonuses for their narrow visible jobs, and any healthy non-Kingambit can still be the legal direct-pressure fallback. Kingambit remains the final queued reserve. Visible board value, current HP, and stable party index resolve ties without converting party order into strategy.

custom_requirements: Preserve the Incineroar plus Urshifu opening and enumerate every legal joint action and target pair, including Close Combat. Define survival against both opposing slots from revealed attacks, observed damage, visible field modifiers, and conservative public-species ranges. Prefer Yveltal while Tailwind is absent or Trick Room is active and this two-slot survival test passes. Never select Tailwind while Tailwind or Trick Room is active; under Trick Room score Snarl, Protect, and Oblivion Wing from summed visible damage and survival value.

Mega Absol must pass the same two-slot survival test and have a burnable physical threat established by a revealed physical action or a direct Knock Off or Play Rough knockout; Protect is defensive, never a selector excuse.

Darkrai must use Disable only against the target's revealed last move and Taunt only into visible setup, recovery, or support value. Icy Wind uses observed turn order and conservative public speed ranges and is suppressed under active Trick Room; direct Dark Pulse is the legal forced-fallback action. No sleep move, hidden speed read, or generic coverage lock exists.

Include the actual Supreme Overlord faint multiplier in damage estimates and withhold Kingambit until at least four visible allied faints with no other healthy reserve. Only an empty legal replacement set may trigger the emergency exception.

Evaluate Kingambit Swords Dance only when it survives the full visible action set of both opposing slots and no revealed Taunt, Encore, Haze, Clear Smog, phazing, or burn line invalidates the turn. Use Sucker Punch only for a visible priority knockout against an established damaging pattern; never read the chosen action or repeat it after failure. Prefer Iron Head or Kowtow Cleave against visible support or non-attacking patterns.
Regression-test Eject Button replacement timing and verify that a Yveltal switch-in applies Dark Aura to Urshifu's same-turn Wicked Blow without scripting the outcome.
Continue using automatic opponent Mega Evolution; Absol is the only Mega candidate.

forbidden_behaviors: Do not choose Explosion on global turn zero or before the first-crack cue has been displayed ahead of action selection.

ai.state_machine: Mode A is a readable lead: turn zero permits Mega Double-Edge, Ice Shard, or Protect but never Explosion, while Toxapex establishes one trap, poison, or Knock Off transition. Mode B selects Chien-Pao, Scarf Chandelure, or Booster Iron Bundle from the current board for distinct physical, special, or speed-control pressure.
